text: うふふ…　どことなく　あなたに　にて　いませんこと？

structure.jp: あなたに　にて　いませんこと？

patterns.name: 〜こと (ladylike question)
patterns.span: にて　いませんこと
patterns.explanation: ませんこと at the end is old-fashioned rich-lady talk for 'isn't it so?', asking you to agree. にて　いませんこと = 'doesn't it look like you?'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: にる 'to resemble' is almost always used with ている, which shows how things are now. あなたに　にて　いません = 'it does not resemble you'.
